senses.gloss: खेट a. [खे अटति, अट्-अच्; खिट्-अच् वा] Having a weapon, armed.

खेट + .{@-टः@}
—1 A village, small town or hamlet; Bhāg. 1. 6. 11.
—2 Phlegm.
—3 The club of Balarāma.
—4 A horse.

खेट + .{@-टम्@}
—1 Grass.
—2 Hide, skin. (N. B.:− At the end of comp. खेट expresses ‘defectiveness’
 or ‘deterioration’, & may be rendered by ‘miserable’, ‘low’, ‘vile’, ‘wretched’
 &c.; नागरखेटम् a miserable town.)
—3 A village; नगराद्योजनं खेटं खेटाद् ग्रामोऽर्धयोजनम् (ब्रह्मानंद पु॰ Part I, II
 अनुषंगपाद. Ch. 7. V. 111.); खेटानि धूलिप्राकारोपेतानि ।
 (प्रश्नव्याकरणसूत्रव्याख्याने).
—4 A village of cultivators; Rājadharmakaustubha, G. O. S. 72, p. 102.
—5 A village two miles long; Bibliotheca Indica 274, Fasc. I. p. 145.

खेटिन् m.
—1 A lecher, libertine.
—2 A citizen.

खेटितानः, -लः
 A minstrel, whose business it is to a waken the master of
 the house with music and singing (वैतालिक.)
